title: PowerPoint Markdown-source smoke eval
objective: Verify that the PowerPoint workflow produces slide-structured Markdown with one H1 per slide before DocBlocks conversion; catalog contract tests cover the PPTX toolset and artifact gate.
prompt: Read source/brief.md and write deck.md for an operations-lead presentation. Use one H1 heading per slide, 6-8 slides, short bullet phrases, and a final next-actions slide. Do not create HTML.

setup.about: The deck source is Markdown and will be converted to editable PPTX by DocBlocks.
setup.missionObjectives: Create a concise, source-grounded deck.md with one H1 per slide and no HTML intermediary.

files.content:
# Boreal Desk Returns Pilot

Audience: operations leads.

Facts:
- Pilot coverage: 18 SKUs.
- Median first response: 18 hours to 6 hours.
- Preventable refund leakage: 14.2% to 8.9%.
- Top unresolved complaint: status silence after photo submission.
- Next actions: automated status emails, barcode-exception training, weekly Finance exception export.

Do not invent other metrics.

success.summary: deck.md is a concise, source-grounded Markdown deck ready for direct PPTX conversion.

checks.pattern: automated status emails|barcode-exception training|weekly Finance exception export

axes.name: narrative
axes.description: The slides form a coherent briefing with one message per slide and a clear closing action.

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Every metric and action comes from the seeded brief.

axes.name: convertibility
axes.description: One H1 per slide and concise block content make the source ready for DocBlocks PPTX conversion.
